en: You're gonna be good, right?
[impatient] He's standing isn't he? Walking around? It was just a pinch of buckshot, nothing to fret.
Alright, how about concerned taxpayer. I want to make sure Crane is dealt with swiftly, and forgive me if I don't have complete faith in the current administration.
Once the mirror's "basically" reconstituted it will, um, "repair" itself. Right Bufkin?
You wanna try putting this magical jigsaw puzzle back together?[beat] It's hard, okay, just give me some time.
[annoyed] You said that fifteen minutes ago.
Once the pieces are put back in order, correct.
And then we can just ask it where Crane went to. It won't work until then.
[mean] So, of course a dumb monkey is the best man for the job.
[mean] No, it won't.
Bufkin knows what he's doing.
Yeah, we'll see.
We shouldn't wait for the mirror.
What can we do until then?
Don't worry, Mr. Bigby, once the mirror can talk it will take us right to him.
I don't want to just go running off into the night without some direction.
We don't have time to wait for the mirror. Crane could be getting on a train right now.
I don't know, really. . .
[muttered to himself] What a surprise.
Where are the Tweedle brothers?
I want to talk with the Tweedle.
And that's if they even know anything.
I could be doing.
I want to talk to the Tweedles. They must know what's going on.
I don't know if you'll get much. Holly and Gren really tore into them. . .
We already looked through his desk.
I want to talk to a Tweedle.
I want to talk with a Tweedle.
Bufkin heard him.
[quietly] Do you really think Crane did it?
How do you know?
Oh yeah? What'd he say?
Crane called somebody before he ran out.
[nervously quiet] Can I ask you something, and you promise you won't think I'm crazy for it?
He said he would need "his witch" for that, or. . . something like. . . that he had to go across town to "get his witch."
Whatever he needs his witch for. . . it seems pretty important.
What do you think the ring does? Why would he want it?
As soon as this mirror's back straightawase, we'll know where he went.
I keep telling you lot, it doesn't matter!
Who knows!
I have no idea.
Maybe it will aid his escape.
A weapon of some kind...?
[sarcastic] Maybe he's raising the dead.
[shocked] What?!
Of course he did it!
And he sent the Tweedle brothers to cover his tracks!
Who else could have!
He's behind everything.
I think he killed Lily...
[tired, but cold] {AngryB} He killed them.
From what I saw tonight at the Open Arms... he's a sick fuck, but...
[tired] {ThinkingA} I'm as confused as you are to be honest. I don't know...
Yes, undoubtedly. I mean, what sort of an idiot would--
[sincerely] I don't think he did.
Am I surrounded by imbeciles! What sort of an idiot would--
[sincerely] I don't think he did, either.
[sincere]  {ThinkingB} He's...he was a conniver, a... a coward, a liar.
{AngryA} He was always telling Fables he was out of town, couldn't see them, couldn't do repairs, couldn't help.
{AngryB} And I'll always hate him for that.
{WorriedA} But murdering prostitutes...[trails off]
And for what, detective? Why go to the trouble?
He saw me in his "room," Bluebeard. He knows the jig is up. He's trying to make an escape.
To best honest... I don't know.
I don't know.[beat] Maybe something to aid his escape.
I don't know much about magic, Snow, I'm just spitballing here.
Really? You think he'd risk that now? When we're right on his trail?
We're not on his trail yet.
Maybe the witch is his next target.
And he could be trying to cover his tracks, get rid of the evidence. If this witch is his supplier of black market glamours. . .
All I know is what I heard him say on the phone.
[coldly sarcastic] You are all just wellsprings of knowledge.
Or planning to turn us all into pumpkins.
Who knows! Not us!
[Coughs] Um, excuse me?
Hi. Hi, Bigby.[correcting herself] Sheriff. I got your number off the directory, I hope you don't mind.
[to Bigby] This is... you remember Vivian. She was a friend of Lily's.
Right. From the funeral.
I'm sorry, uh. . . the door was unlocked.
[quiet] In private?
I was a friend of Lily's. . . where she worked.
At the Pudding N' Pie.
Wait. Who are you?
I don't have time for you right now.
Thanks, thanks so much.
[awkwardly] Suuuure. Uh, we can go into my office. It's right down the hall.
[whispered] Sorry.
He'll talk to you in his office.
There's nothing to do until the mirror's repaired. [quietly to him]She might know something.
It's, um, it's hard to explain.
I'd just. . . I'd love just a minute of your time.
I don't really have time right now.
I'm sorry, it's just. . . I'd love just a minute of your time.
I didn't want to say in front of what's her name. It's a. . . security issue. We shouldn't let it out that the Magic Mirror's not working.
[sadly] Crane must have taken a shard when he left.
[coldly angry] {AngryA} I knew this stupid plan wouldn't work.
Oh, what? You think Fables will start looting Times Square if they know you can't spy on them anymore?
What did Vivian say?
[getting angry] I just don't want to add to the pile of reasons people already have to start panicking.
{AngryA} Oh, you knew did you?
[muttering to himself] This is unbelievable.
[sad] It can't re-form without all the pieces. Crane would've known that.
Nothing really important. She just, uh, she just felt bad about everything.
She knew about Crane.
Wait, why the fuck is Bluebeard here?
[cold] I bet she did.
She knew about Crane, and. . . Lily making herself to look like you.
She wanted to apologize.
She feels responsible since. . . she's kind of the girls' watcher, I guess.
I dunno. She was embarrassed, I guess.
This isn't trivial.
And I'm not saying it is!
The mirror.
What isn't trivial.
{AngryA} This farce was your ridiculous idea for a plan. I mean, who put you in charge in the first place?
I didn't say that I was "in charge," alright, he asked what the priorities would be and I told him.
And that you'd be running the office temporarily.
While you were waiting to get sewn up, I heard her tell Swineheart that she was in charge! Her!
{AngryC} Fixing the mirror was the most logical thing!
Yeah, and that I'd be running the office temporarily! Of anyone standing in this room, that's the obvious choice since I've been doing it unofficially for years now!
{ConfusedA} Hey!
{AngryA} And all we've done is exactly what Crane wanted us to do, which is waste precious time that'd have been better spent cooking and eating this wretched monkey!
{AngryA} "Unofficially" is not "officially."
Who elected you to make these decisions
How is it being spent!
Tell me: where will the money go now?
I'm heading this investigation.
Snow can handle it.
[ice cold] If you want to stay here and field phone calls and complaints and run to the market to find newt's milk for fairies at a moment's notice, be my guest...
{NormalB} I'm heading up the investigation, okay, Bluebeard? That makes this a moot point.
[ice cold] Running the Business Office is a twenty four hour job, Sheriff.
Why do you care who watches after the Business Office so much? It's a thankless job.
There's more timely things to be worrying about. . . but no, not bigger.
{NormalB} There's much bigger things to be worrying about right now, alright?
{NormalA} It'll have to do for now.
We can't get Mayor Cole on the phone and suddenly she's the lord and high council!
[ice cold] If you "think about it?" Running the Business Office is a twenty four hour job, Sheriff.
When word gets out she'd been given unfettered access to everything here-- the treasure, the armory-- forget about panic, there'll be a riot.
She wasn't elected to this post!
[pissed] It's not his decision.
Forget him, okay. It's fine. I know the rules and how this works. It'll be fine.
And it's certainly not yours!
Bluebeard's right.
Snow's in charge.
I don't care who's the boss.
Just close the Business Office! Close it down!
What would you even have me do?
Doesn't that make the most sense?
We don't want to make things more complicated than they already are. Maybe we should just close the Business Office... until things get more.. . sorted.
Snow... Bluebeard's right.
It's not your decision.[beat] The Fables still need help. And I'm gonna help them, with or without you.
[betrayed] Bigby...
Snow knows better than anyone how to run this place, Bluebeard.
When they come for you in the night with pitchforks and torches, don't come crying to me.
Right now, I could not care less who's "in charge.
Hey, it's no skin off my teeth. But when they come for you in the night with pitchforks and torches, don't come crying to me.
And Bigby knows what I'm saying is right, he just doesn't want to say so in front of you.
[tired sigh] {SarcasticA} Alright, let's just look on the bright side. We know Crane is going to see the witch that's been supplying him black market glamours.
[happily] Right.
And Vivian said that Holly would have the witch's information with Lily's things.
"Might have."
And could be burning it as we speak, so if you're gonna go somewhere you should go--
[plainly; already leaving] Great. And I'll go to Crane's apartment.
[surprised] Wait, what? Crane's apartment?
And why the Hell not?
We already looked for the key, remember? I don't know where it is.
Grimble's trying to find a spare.
[angry] Then I'll pick the blasted lock![beat; calms himself] I wasted enough time waiting for the mirror to find him. I won't waste any more.
Just wait! Wait a minute!
The Tweedles are still a link.
[a little annoyed] The Tweedles can barely speak.
Yeah, but, I mean. . . they have something to do with this, and. . . we don't know what yet.
[quieter] I mean, just. . . maybe they know where his witch is.
Or they know nothing and you'll waste a trip while Holly is burning her sister's stuff which does have the info.
If you're so nervous about me going, why don't you come with?
[aggravated] You know I can't leave. The town is starting to wake up to all of this and I have to wait for Mayor Cole's callback.
[decisively] Fine then. I'm going upstairs, I don't care what you two do.
{NormalA} Before you had no interest and now it's a crime scene!
{ThinkingB} You just can't go up there alone, alright?
I can hear you, you know.
{NormalA} Oh, now it's evidence!
{AngryC} What concerns me is you traipsing through possible evidence.
{CockyA} I've no interest in nicking his drapes, my dear, if that's what concerns you.
We can't just let Bluebeard run amok in Crane's place.
{AngryB} Fine, I don't care, just go ahead.
{AngryA} Really now! And what, you're gonna stand here and babysit me while the rest of your "leads" evaporate into mist?
{NormalB} Bluebeard, you're not going anywhere.
{AngryA} They can't get any more "messed up."
Why don't you just stay here with Snow and help out with things?
["of course" tone] Yeah, that's where I'm going.
You can't just go up there.
They have something to do with this, Snow. They might know where his witch is, who his witch is. . .
I'm saving him the trouble!
[forceful whisper] There is no way he is going up there just to "find Crane." He's planning something.
[cold] {AngryA} I don't like you going anywhere unsupervised.
Look, you go and check in with the Tweedles or Holly while I go investigate Crane's apartment. Deal?
Unless Bigby decides he'd rather waste his time, I suggest you start learning to like it.
For what?
And. . . I'm sorry for not saying anything earlier. Before it was too late.
[shy] I knew Lily was pretending to be Snow.[beat] I'd known for a little while.
I hadn't seen the, uh, the "room," so. . .
But I know that doesn't make it alright.
I didn't know the obsession had gotten as bad as it had.
[quietly] I'm sorry.
I can't. . . I can't deliberately say for what, but. . . I can say that:
I'm sorry about Lily, and I'm sorry about Snow, and I'm sorry that I knew their connection. . .
My lips are sealed.
Wait, just. . . let me. . .
[quietly] That's what I came here to tell you.
It's really not your fault.
You should've said something sooner.
Why tell me now?
You could've come here sooner. You should've come here sooner.
[sad] I know.
[quietly] Are you gonna catch him?
And. . . if the little sister gets in trouble, it's the older sister's fault, really. For not teaching her right.
[sad] I'm Georgie's favorite, you know.[beat] I don't have to dance, don't have to go out on dates. . .
[sad] I feel responsible.
[sad] I just answer the phone, and schedule, and. . . the "rules" are the same for me, you know, but. . . I kind of feel like with the girls. . . Georgie's the dad and I'm the older sister.
[sad] And so I guess I just wanted to say, "I'm sorry,". . . out loud. . . to someone, since. . . [big sigh]
Okay. . .
[quietly] . . . what I came here to tell ya.
[quietly] That's what I. . .
Wait. . . wait, just let me. . .
I [struggles]. . . knew what he was doing. . .With her.[beat] Who he made her look like.
And I'm sorry that I didn't come here to. . . to at least try to tell you about it. . . before. . . everything.
And if I could help you anymore than that, I would.
Bufkin's finished.
I should be heading back anyway.
Actually, wait.
Would Lily have had information about the witch Crane used to glamour her?
Maybe. She might have.
Holly has all of Lily's stuff.
Have a safe trip back.
Give us a minute.
Alright, I'm coming.
Knock next time.
Give us one more minute, okay?
[strained] I think we're about out of minutes.
Alright. I'm coming.
I did knock.
Knock next time, will ya?
Sorry to interrupt. How's it going?
[quietly] As well as can be.
I want to talk with the Tweedles.
I don't know if you'll get much. Holly and Gren really tore into them.
But it is something we could be doing.
[calmly] You don't remember me?
The Tweedles would know.
The Tweedle would know.
[sore] Mph.
[plainly] Do you remember what happened?
[disbelieving] Really.
I remember most of it, alright?
Yeah. I remember.
I have to explain some things. Let me do my job first. . . and then I'll let you go off and do yours.
Ichabod isn't here, and he wasn't in the Business Office when we brought you in.
I don't have a "moment."
We can get to that in moment.
That true?
[mildly depressed] Yeah.
[groggy; waking up] Who are you?
I'm Dr. Swineheart, the Fables physician.
